requiredFindings.title: NoRepository::covers binds pathname labels rather than the retained root
requiredFindings.description: The r1 cross-spelling reproduction is rejected, but covers consults only chain.spelling(), component_count(), and Sample::Absent labels. TrackingObservation still carries no binding to the retained chain/root that observe_tracking actually used. Two retained chains for different directory objects at the same spelling therefore have identical inputs to covers. A token obtained for the first non-repository root authorizes the second root even when the latter is inside a repository. observe_members subsequently opens members relative to the independently supplied second chain without checking VCS markers at W or its ancestors. R1-RF-2 is only partially resolved.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Bind the observation/proof to the retained chain/root used by 6a and derive W from that binding or validate retained identity before member work. Add a same-spelling/different-retained-root substitution control, preserving the existing cross-spelling control. Pathname absence labels alone are insufficient; do not require a fresh Git recheck merely to solve token-to-root binding.

nonBlockingObservations.title: The custody mutation bypasses the fault injector rather than reproducing a latch
nonBlockingObservations.description: member-custody-latches replaces Pass::Members judging with judge_project_object, bypassing judge_decided and its injected_capture hook. Its two archived failures are admitted/admitted versus the requested refusal vectors, rather than Budget(Closed). This is a meaningful guard against that replacement but does not independently demonstrate a fault crossing a latching capture scope. Consider injecting at the native capture boundary so an observed-to-accounted capture mutation is caught with the same injected error.
